SQL computes case when funds.gen_accountname is null then 0 else 1, compares with isnull(gen_isfundinternalagent,0), Sort on accountid (key position 1), then Update accountbase set gen_isfundinternalagent=? where accountid=?.
Decision tree matches the SQL; 'type 1 = internal agent' is labelled hypothesis.

SQL, joins, Sort, parameter order (Param_0 <- gen_isfundinternalagent, Param_1 <- accountid) and FailComponent all verified. But unit [2] enumerates which funds are not counted and attributes exclusion only to the INNER JOINs; it omits that a fund whose gen_estatecodeid row has gen_estatetypeid NULL is also excluded, because 'NULL not in (...)' is UNKNOWN in SQL. It also describes gen_fundmain.gen_accountname as the account being the fund's 'owner' (בעליהן), which is an interpretation; the file only proves the join gen_fundmain.gen_accountname = accountid.
